steps.message:
I found it — `config.js:3`, `SESSION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES: 30`, consumed by `server.js` as the session expiry.

Before I change it: this is a one-line edit, but the consequence lands outside those lines. Going 30 minutes → 8 hours (480) means an authenticated session stays valid 16× longer. A stolen session token, an unattended logged-in machine, or a session that should have been invalidated after a permission change all stay exploitable for a full working day instead of half an hour. That's a security-posture change, not a config tweak, so I want an explicit yes before I make it.
